errors.evidence: The x-axis ticks are in half-year intervals (Januar, Juli), not quarterly intervals (Quartalsintervallen).

errors.text_span: mit Beschriftungen für jedes erste Quartal eines Jahres
errors.evidence: The x-axis has labels for both January and July of each year, not just the first quarter.

errors.text_span: Die linke Achse zeigt den Indexwert des realen Mindestlohns (HVPI-basierter Index),
errors.evidence: The chart has only one y-axis, which is shared by all three lines. It does not have a separate left axis specifically for the real minimum wage.

errors.text_span: mit einem leichten Anstieg bis etwa 2017
errors.evidence: The purple line (Realer Mindestlohn) does not show a slight increase until 2017. It fluctuates and generally decreases slightly from its starting point of 100.
The low point for the purple line around this time is approximately 96.5 in July 2018, not 95.

errors.text_span: erreicht im Januar 2023 einen Spitzenwert von etwa 115
errors.evidence: The peak of the purple line in January 2023 is at approximately 113, not 115.

errors.text_span: bevor er bis Januar 2025 auf etwa 111 sinkt
errors.evidence: The purple line does not sink to 111 by January 2025. After some fluctuations, its final data point in January 2025 is a sharp upward spike to a value of approximately 114.

errors.text_span: die blaue durchgezogene Linie repräsentiert den Index, der auf dem 4. Quartal 2022 mit 112,1 normiert ist, beginnt bei 100 im Januar 2015
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly describes the dark blue line. The line normalized to Q4 2022 does not start in January 2015; it starts in early 2023. The description confuses this line with the light blue line, which does start in 2015.

errors.text_span: steigt bis zum Januar 2017 auf etwa 106
errors.evidence: In the description of the light blue line, it claims the value reaches 106 by Jan 2017, but the chart shows the value is approximately 102 at that time.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bis Januar 2025 auf etwa 111 ansteigt
errors.evidence: The light blue line ends in early 2023. It does not continue to January 2025. The dark blue line ends around 111 in January 2025, but this description is for the light blue line.
